exclusion_reason: Instant-play redistributable hosting is implemented: publication is gated by the license/reuse/provenance graph so an in-date grant publishes a hosted-title descriptor while an expired grant or unlicensed component is refused outright. The benchmark stays red because measuring cold-browser time-to-interactive on the hosted title needs the absent browser game runtime.
promotion_trigger: Promote when the hosted title reaches interactive from cold start and the expired-grant publication is refused.
active_gate_evidence: test/library.test.mjs asserts an in-date grant publishes, an expired grant is refused naming the expiry, and an unlicensed project is refused.
procedure: Publish the hosted title with an in-date grant.
Load from a cold browser and measure time to interactive.
Attempt publication with an expired grant and assert refusal.
